    What's on

    About us

    We produce exceptional in-house professional theatre.  

    We stage outstanding School productions. 

    We are a home for a carefully curated programme of community productions and groups.

     

     

    Praise for Alice in Wonderland:

    ‘Brilliantly Bonkers twist on the classic tale’ **** The Theatre Talk

    ‘This was Shakespeare at its very best: authentic, engaging and emotionally powerful’ ***** Fairy Powered Productions

    ‘The language is faithfully Shakespearean, but the staging and atmosphere are cutting-edge’ ***** The Theatre Talk

    Upcoming in house professional shows

    Romeo and Juliet

    After the success of Macbeth, we’re thrilled to announce our next Shakespeare performance: Romeo and Juliet.


    Join us as we bring this timeless tale of love, passion, and fate to the stage.

    ​

    Box office open now!

    Book now

    a christmas carol

    Get ready for the third in-house Christmas spectacular: A Christmas Carol!


    Join us for a magical retelling of Charles Dickens’ classic tale as Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts of Christmas past, present, and future. Packed with festive cheer, heart, and a sprinkle of theatre magic, this is the perfect way to celebrate the season with family and friends.

    Book now!

    Plan your vist

    The Grange Theatre is easy to reach by car or public transport. We have a free car park directly opposite the venue. The nearest train station is Greenback and Hartford, just a short taxi ride or walk away, with regular services from Liverpool, Manchester and surrounding areas.

    — Name, Title

    Parking information

    Refreshments

    Make your visit extra special with a trip to our theatre refreshments bar, run by Ice Cream Creations. Enjoy a selection of wines, beers, spirits, soft drinks, and delicious ice creams made by Ice Cream Creations before the show or during the interval. Take advantage of our pre-order service to skip the queues and make the most of your visit.

    More information

    Get involved

    The Grange Theatre is home to both our Young Company and Elders Company, giving performers of all ages the chance to take part in exciting productions throughout the year. Whether you’re just starting out or returning to the stage, our friendly groups are a fantastic way to build confidence, make new friends, and be part of our theatre community.
